title: Computations in Homotopy Theory
institution: Hausdorff School for Mathematics (HSM), University of Bonn
about: The Hausdorff School for Mathematics at the University of Bonn, Germany, holds the Special Topic School "Computations in Homotopy Theory" from 10 to 14 May 2027, a one-week seminar for early-career researchers. The call for participation closes 8 January 2027.
